summary: Novo Nordisk A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting daily transactions under its ongoing share repurchase programme, part of a DKK 15 billion 12-month buyback begun 4 February 2026, with a sub-tranche of up to DKK 11.2 billion running 6 May 2026 to 1 February 2027 under EU MAR Safe Harbour Rules. For 14-18 September 2026, it bought 1,090,000 B shares at average DKK 281.51 to DKK 275.54, bringing cumulative programme repurchases to 19,415,000 shares for DKK 5.83 billion; treasury holdings are 48,214,876 B shares, or 1.1% of capital. Watch execution pace against the DKK 15 billion authorization and any price sensitivity.
